exposure: Labor induction with extra-amniotic Foley catheter
Labor induction with vaginal tablets of prostaglandin E2
cohort: 346 nulliparous women with a cervical Bishop score < 6 who underwent induction of labor
finding: Induction of labor with a Foley catheter in nulliparous women with an unfavorable cervix is associated with a shorter induction to delivery interval, but similar rates of cesarean deliveries and adverse pregnancy outcomes, compared to vaginal tablets of prostaglandin E2.
